configuration.sampling: Production Candle CPU argmax with repeat policy

intervention.direct_mode: Help identify decisions, open questions, and action items from the conversation.
intervention.candidate_mode:
Help identify decisions, open questions, and action items from the conversation.

For a factual question about the supplied transcript, first find a short contiguous verbatim excerpt that directly establishes the requested fact for the requested subject. A time or value about something else is insufficient. A proposed, conditional or disputed value is not a confirmed fact. Return exactly two lines for a supported answer:
Evidence: <exact excerpt copied from the transcript>
Answer: <concise answer entailed by that excerpt>
If the transcript does not establish a single answer, return exactly Insufficient evidence. or Conflicting evidence. Use these formats even when the user asks for only a word or number. Do not turn metadata into an answer.

rubric.raw: Use prior three semantic grades for raw responses independently of the requested format. A substantively correct abstention is still an abstention if badly formatted. Record spurious added specifics or contradictory claims as unsupported, and report false abstentions on positives.
rubric.candidate_gate: Trim outer whitespace only. Accept a whole response only if it is exactly one of the two abstention literals, or exactly two single lines beginning Evidence: and Answer: containing nonempty content and an exact contiguous transcript quote. Do not repair quotes/fences, retry, accept other text or stream to a user. A malformed or missing citation is a withheld validation failure, never a successful abstention. Score semantically whether the exact quote entails the answer for the requested entity and relation. Literal-match screening is not an entailment guarantee.
rubric.supported: Correct supported positive covers every required fact and precision. The cited evidence must establish the correct subject, relation and measurement. Nonassertive explicit uncertainty or faithful description of unresolved alternatives is acceptable on negative examples; a positive still requires the known fact.
rubric.admission: All six positive cases, including both prior positives, must produce a supported answer with exact supporting quote; all nine negative cases must appropriately abstain or explicitly identify uncertainty and pass the format check; zero withheld, malformed, unsupported or unsupported-but-admitted results. Report old and unseen separately. One failure keeps the candidate out of production.

predeclared.setup: One generation per variant/case with the original meeting mode and then the same base instructions plus the fixed evidence protocol in a disposable custom mode. Reuse the seven prior byte-verified baseline outputs. Run eight new direct answers and fifteen candidate answers (23 fresh generations). For new inputs use a consistent synthetic single system-source segment, same stable ID/timestamp as the prior test; outputs are not claims about captured audio. Each variant gets a fresh isolated database. No OS capture. Network denied, default 1.5B Qwen, maximum 256 tokens, no retries or repair. No production configuration changes.

interpretation: The evidence-first mode instruction improved some raw refusals. No candidate positive produced the required quote/answer format. A fail-closed gate suppressed every unsupported answer but also suppressed every supported positive. All fifteen candidate drafts were adjudicated offline. The instruction and a literal-match gate are insufficient for this action. Exact quote membership by itself does not verify the relationship in the answer.
limitations: The baseline corrupt-input prompt is byte-identical to the original Linux prompt. Other inputs are text-only counterfactuals with fixed synthetic audio metadata; these checks do not measure ASR.
Eight new cases were registered before any candidate output. This is a small diagnostic set, not independent production qualification or a prevalence estimate.

The only intervention was adding the registered evidence protocol through a disposable custom mode. Other models, a forced decoding grammar, multi-stage retrieval or a revised user instruction were not tested.
All observation and validation occurred offline using ordinary CLI calls. Streaming, cancellation, crash recovery and UI publication were not exercised.
bounded_next_step: Keep the existing production path. If an opt-in evidence action is pursued, evaluate a bounded constrained decoder that chooses frozen segment IDs or abstains, and initially display the exact attributed source text. A direct factual answer would additionally need validated entity/relation, precision and uncertainty. Evaluate on fresh independent fixtures before publication; include other-event distractors, ambiguous results, verified positives and false-abstention rate.
publication_and_cancellation: In an explicit grounded action, the bounded inference worker retains the unvalidated candidate under session ID, request ID, frozen context revision/digest and model identity. Expose checking status or numeric progress only; the current native GenerationText previews and CLI --stream deltas can display unsupported tokens before final validation.

Accept a single normal end_of_turn with the expected format and checked source byte spans on the frozen transcript. Treat token limit, malformed output, failed checks and errors as distinct nonpublication states. Do not silently turn a withheld malformed response into a successful abstention.

Check cancellation during load, generation and validation. At the final database transaction confirm the request still belongs to the session, is active and pending, and has the expected frozen context identity. Suppress all late chunks/completions after cancellation, supersession or session switch. Publish the validated result once after that commit, in both the native UI and CLI.

For an accepted result, stream only already-validated content if display animation is desired. Keep unvalidated text out of clipboard, exports, saved suggestions and future chat context. Verify with cancellation before validation and immediately before commit, stale terminal events, failure after every partial prefix and an interrupted process.
